{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Remove QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_mask = df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99
df_clean = df[~qa_mask].copy()

# Drop refunded orders since they are not conversions
# Only 'completed' orders count as conversions in the numerator
completed_mask = df_clean['status'] == 'completed'
df_completed = df_clean[completed_mask].copy()

# Calculate conversion rate by customer_segment
# Conversion rate = (number of converted orders) / (total completed orders)
conversion_rates = df_completed.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].agg(['count', 'sum'])
conversion_rates['conversion_rate'] = conversion_rates['sum'] / conversion_rates['count']

# Sort by conversion rate to find the highest
highest_segment = conversion_rates['conversion_rate'].idxmax()

# Print results
conversion_rates, highest_segment"}
